surface: gh plate pr preflight/create, plate_core.pr_gates_checks, plate-pr-gates failure text
summary: Local PR preflight runs plate-pr-gates and labels checks before gh pr create; CI issue-link failures include the exact Closes line to add.
migration_impact: Agents should prefer `gh plate pr create` or run `gh plate pr preflight` before opening PRs. Adopters import regenerated plate-pr-gates.yml when syncing payload.
agent_notes: Run `gh plate pr preflight --body-file body.md --base release --labels Feature,area:cli` (or `gh plate pr create -- …`) before spending tokens on CI fix-ups. Shared checks live in plate_core.pr_gates_checks.
